checks.detail: The actual positive generated wedge is proved equal to two closed halfplanes by explicit nonnegative coefficients.
Genuine complex polar-coordinate membership is proved equivalent to phi in the closed interval [0,theta], for 0<theta<pi.
Direct polar Gaussian integration over the actual cone gives theta; boundary rays are included and no arc equality is supplied as a hypothesis.
A concrete norm-preserving complex rotation and optional reflection send the first unit ray to1 and the second into the upper halfplane; selected nonparallelism excludes both angular degeneracies.
The actual ordinary endpoint angle is derived via arg/arccos and preserved inner products; volume-preserving Euclidean isometries transport Gaussian mass.
The arbitrary real Euclidean plane wrapper constructs its isometry from an actual orthonormal basis and fixed finrank2; actual polar angular normalization is retained.

normalization: Euclidean orthogonal chart volume and Euclidean-volume polar angular measure; no equality to diameter-normalized raw Mathlib Hausdorff measure asserted.
not_claimed: All-threshold actual irredundant facet/ridge selection for nonsimple polyhedra
